channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran urges Iraq to lift flight ban amid US sanctions
item.description: Iran calls on Iraq to remove flight curbs after US sanctions, in a move that has strained bilateral ties.

item.title: US to send third aircraft carrier towards Iran: US official to Al Jazeera
item.description: Massive US military deployment to the Middle East includes 50,000 troops, F-35s and Marines to pressure Tehran.

item.title: Trump launches midterms campaign blitz amid record low approval ratings
item.description: In a series of campaign-style rallies, Trump seeks to boost Republican odds amid Iran war and rising fuel costs.

item.title: Iran war live: US moves 2,000 Marines to Middle East, tanker hit in Hormuz
item.description: US deploys Roosevelt strike group and 2,000 Marines to the Middle East as part of a wider buildup around Iran.

item.title: Israeli drone kills Palestinian in Gaza, settlers kill another in West Bank
item.description: 1,439 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza and 5,052 injured since the 'ceasefire' began in October 2025.

item.title: Russia’s Putin rules out ceasefire with Ukraine during speech in Moscow
item.description: Putin warned the West he would deploy nuclear weapons if necessary to defend the Russian Baltic exclave of Kaliningrad.

item.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
item.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

item.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
item.description: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.

item.title: Who is the 'hero' Indian pilot who was stabbed on Israel-bound flight?
item.description: Capt Smit Machchhar was attacked by another pilot onboard the Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv.

item.title: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger
item.description: An aeroplane flying to Israel fell 17,000ft (5,200m) in less than two minutes before it was diverted.
